title: Conversation Archive Request
description: Request schema for the archive_conversation workflow.

conversation_id.description: Stable identifier for the archived interaction.

conversation_title.description: Human-readable title of the archived interaction.

project.description: Project or workstream associated with the archived interaction.

extraction_type.description: Type of archive extraction performed by the workflow.

start_time.description: Start timestamp of the archived interaction scope.

end_time.description: End timestamp of the archived interaction scope.

message_count.description: Number of messages included in the archived interaction.

messages.description: Ordered message list captured from the interaction.

source.description: Optional public source category, such as chat or workflow.

source_platform.description: Optional public platform label for the originating client.
